wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Stocks Pare Losses as Tech Selloff Eases
wsjHeadlines.description: Nasdaq tumbles; Nvidia and Micron slump

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Can’t Seem to Find Its Footing in the Chaos of the New AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: The Nasdaq composite plunged as much as 4.5% Wednesday before paring losses.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stocks Finish Lower After Wild Session
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, tariffs are back on the agenda and Nvidia gets a warning

wsjHeadlines.title: Dan Loeb’s Hedge Fund Returns to Startup Investing Years After FTX Loss
wsjHeadlines.description: The billionaire told investors that Third Point overhauled its process for investing in late-stage private companies.

wsjHeadlines.title: Jamie Dimon Loved Britain—Until It Raised Taxes on JPMorgan
wsjHeadlines.description: The chief executive wants to strike back against the U.K. after its cash-strapped government targeted banks for extra revenue.

wsjHeadlines.title: The AI Grinch Won’t Steal Christmas, but Watch Next Year
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Anthropic’s slide continues

wsjHeadlines.title: The Car Industry Has a Seat-Belt Problem It Can’t Fix
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Jensen Huang’s vision for the new Nvidia is a lot like the old one, and our game tests whether you can secure your money for old age.

wsjHeadlines.title: Where to Find Bargains After the AI Power Boom Reality Check
wsjHeadlines.description: The sharp correction to power stocks creates an opportunity for investors.

wsjHeadlines.title: For Better or Worse, the Fate of the AI Boom Is in Nvidia’s Hands
wsjHeadlines.description: An emboldened Jensen Huang could build up risks for the next crisis.

wsjHeadlines.title: Disney Bets Big on Streaming. Just Don’t Ask What It Costs.
wsjHeadlines.description: More content, sports and maybe a free tier aim to make streaming a growth engine.

wsjHeadlines.title: James Bond’s Bare Wrist Sets Off Watch Industry War
wsjHeadlines.description: 007 has worn an Omega watch for three decades, but the brand was missing from the big reveal.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Shares Are a Rational Bet on the Next Phase of AI
wsjHeadlines.description: The artificial-intelligence boom’s profits today go mostly to picks and shovels, but that will shift.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on France’s sovereign rating, Fitch Rating’s 2027 U.S. banks sector outlook, Saudi Arabia’s banking sector and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Citi Undercounted $35 Billion in Assets at U.K. Subsidiary
wsjHeadlines.description: The record-keeping blunder, which was related to risk-weighted assets, is a setback for CEO Jane Fraser’s efforts to strengthen internal controls.

wsjHeadlines.title: British Bank Backed by Kushner’s Affinity Gets U.S. License
wsjHeadlines.description: OakNorth looks across the Atlantic to lend more to growing companies.

wsjHeadlines.title: Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data Leaked by Hackers
wsjHeadlines.description: The incident involved data belonging to thousands of customers, but it isn’t disrupting payment services or connected to banking issues earlier this week.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Pledged to Mobilize $500 Billion for Nvidia—but Hasn’t Put Up a Dime
wsjHeadlines.description: A wave of money that was supposed to help customers keep buying Nvidia chips hasn’t materialized.

wsjHeadlines.title: Treasury Yields Extend Fall After U.S. Data Flurry
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. Treasury yields briefly extended their fall  after a flurry of U.S. economic data including the personal consumption expenditures price index, the Federal Reserve’s preferred gauge of inflation.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dodgers Owner Todd Boehly Clinches Deal for Overseas Assets of Russia’s Lukoil
wsjHeadlines.description: The sale was initially sparked after the Trump administration slapped sanctions on Lukoil assets to pressure Moscow in negotiations over the war in Ukraine.

wsjHeadlines.title: Health Care Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Sanofi, Sandoz Group, Genmab and more in the latest Market Talks covering the Health Care sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Hannover Re, AXA, Malayan Banking and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Energy & Utilities Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on oil futures, Repsol, Galp Energia and more in the latest Market Talks covering Energy and Utilities.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed as Nvidia, AI Rout Continues
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks finished mixed as the tech sector gave back more of the gains garnered in the wake of Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia CEO.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stocks Pare Losses as Anthropic Shares Swing Higher
wsjHeadlines.description: Stocks were paring their losses heading into the Thanksgiving holiday.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Nvidia, Dell, Workday and more in the latest Market Talks covering Technology, Media and Telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Newly-Listed Airtel Mobile to Replace IG Group in FTSE 100 Index Review
wsjHeadlines.description: Airtel Mobile Commerce is expected to join London’s premier FTSE 100 index as part of the next quarterly review replacing IG Group Holdings, according to indicative data from FTSE Russell.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Stock Indexes Mostly Higher as Industrials, Luxuries Gain
wsjHeadlines.description: Energy-intensive stocks rose as oil prices fell, though tech stocks extended losses as the bounce following Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia CEO continued to fade.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Government Gets a Tax Windfall From Anthropic
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. companies take a large share of the burden.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | How to Kill a Bull Market
wsjHeadlines.description: Politicians have a say in how deep the AI correction becomes.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Give Thanks to Inverse Billionaires
wsjHeadlines.description: Tech leaders capture only 4% of the wealth they create. Everyone else splits the rest.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Why China Wants to Control a Yacht Maker
wsjHeadlines.description: The story of Italy’s Ferretti Group points to a vulnerability in the West’s system to control investment by foreign adversaries.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Astonishing Wealth of Anthropic
wsjHeadlines.description: Investors weren’t fazed by doubts about AI after the Nvidia tumult.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Last Week’s Outages Were Only the Start
wsjHeadlines.description: With AI’s power growing faster than we can keep up, we can expect a difficult two to three years.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures End Lower As December Contract Expires
wsjHeadlines.description: Natural gas futures ended the session lower after the EIA’s weekly storage report showed a 24 Bcf draw.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Settle Off Day’s Lows as Yields, U.S. Dollar Slip
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures settled lower for a second straight session as precious metals remain pressured by dollar strength and expectations that inflation will drive the Fed to raise interest rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Petronas Chemicals, Monadelphous and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Copper Slumps Amid AI Roller Coaster But Physical Supply Remains Tight
wsjHeadlines.description: The metal was heading for one of its worst monthly performances in more than a decade as investors retreated from riskier assets and tariff uncertainty clouded the global demand outlook.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Crude Oil Stockpiles Rise for Third Straight Week
wsjHeadlines.description: Commercial crude oil stocks rose by 1.1 million barrels last week, matching analyst expectations.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Dollar Slips After Muted Reaction to U.S. Data
wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar turned lower as earlier strength following a raft of economic indicators faded.

wsjHeadlines.title: The WSJ Dollar Index Falls 0.27% to 98.75
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index fell 0.27%, down two of the past three trading days.
